metadata.description: Channel and tooling plugins for Claude Code, maintained by RIA Systems (verified Meta Tech Provider).

plugins.name: whatsapp
plugins.description: WhatsApp channel for Claude Code — messaging bridge built on the official Meta Cloud API, with built-in access control. Manage pairing, allowlists, and policy via /whatsapp:access.

plugins.name: instagram
plugins.description: Instagram channel for Claude Code — read and reply to comments AND direct messages via the official Graph API. Built-in comment-to-DM bootstrap, audio transcription, and access control via /instagram:access.
